digo_source: Mgombato; Pakia ('Mpapali'; varieties moyo wa simba - red flesh, moyo mwereru)

teaser.en: The Digo call one red-fleshed pawpaw *moyo wa simba*, 'lion's heart'.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huita aina moja ya papai lenye nyama nyekundu *moyo wa simba*.
teaser.dg: Adigo nkuiha aina mwenga ya papali yenye nyama ya kundu *moyo wa simba*.

summary.en: *Mpapali* is the pawpaw or papaya, a fast-growing garden plant found in homesteads all over the coast. It gives ripe fruit to eat, green fruit to cook and a natural meat tenderiser.
summary.sw: *Mpapali* ni mpapai, mmea wa bustanini unaokua haraka na unaopatikana katika makazi kote pwani. Hutoa matunda mabivu ya kula, mabichi ya kupika, na kilainishi asilia cha nyama.
summary.dg: *Mpapali* ni muhi wa papali (*pawpaw* au *papaya* kpwa Chingereza), mmea wa busitani unaokula upesi, unaophahikana midzini kosi pwani. Unalavya matunda maivu ga kurya, matunda maitsi ga kujita, na chitu cha chienyeji cha kuhenda nyama ikale yuya.

about.en:
*Mpapali* looks like a small tree but has a soft, hollow, unbranched stem marked with leaf scars. At the top sits a crown of large, deeply lobed leaves on long stalks, and the fruits hang in a cluster just below them, pressed against the stem.

The fruit turns from green to yellow or orange as it ripens. Inside, the flesh is orange or red around a hollow filled with small black seeds. Cut the green fruit and a white milky sap runs out.
about.sw:
*Mpapali* huonekana kama mti mdogo lakini una shina laini, lenye uwazi ndani na lisilo na matawi, lenye alama za mahali majani yalipodondoka. Juu kabisa kuna taji la majani makubwa yenye mapengo marefu juu ya mikono mirefu, na matunda huning'inia kwa kishada chini yake kidogo, yakiwa yamegandamana na shina.

Tunda hubadilika kutoka kijani hadi njano au rangi ya chungwa linapoiva. Ndani, nyama yake ni ya rangi ya chungwa au nyekundu ikizunguka uwazi uliojaa mbegu ndogo nyeusi. Ukikata tunda bichi, utomvu mweupe kama maziwa hutiririka.
about.dg:
*Mpapali* unaoneka dza muhi mdide, ela una kolo laini, risiro na chitu ndani na risiro na panda, renye alama za makodza garigogbwa. Dzulu kuna chitswa cha makodza makulu genye mala manji, kpwenye milita mire, na matunda ganabwadzika phamwenga photsi yago, ganagandamana na kolo.

Tunda rinagaluka kula rangi ya chijani kukala ya rangi ya mandano au ya chungbwa richiivwa. Ndani, nyama ni ya rangi ya chungbwa au ya kundu, na kahi kuna utupu uriodzala tembe didide nyiru. Uchikata tunda ritsi, maziya ga rangi nyereru ganatuluka.

where.en: Pawpaw is grown in homestead gardens across the south coast. It springs up easily from seed and fruits within a year or so, so plants of every size are often seen around a single compound.
where.sw: Mpapai hupandwa katika bustani za nyumbani kote pwani ya kusini. Huota kwa urahisi kutokana na mbegu na huzaa ndani ya takriban mwaka mmoja, hivyo mara nyingi huonekana mipapai ya kila ukubwa kuzunguka boma moja.
where.dg: *Mpapali* unaphandwa kpwenye busitani za midzi kosi pwani ya kusini. Unamera upesi kula tembe na unalavya matunda bada ya mwaka mmwenga hivi, kpwa hivyo mara nyinji mipapali midide na mikulu inaonekana kuzunguluka mudzi mmwenga.

uses.en: The ripe fruit is eaten fresh. Green fruit is cooked as a vegetable. The plant is also used as a meat tenderiser, thanks to the enzyme in its milky sap, which softens meat.
uses.sw: Tunda bivu huliwa likiwa freshi. Tunda bichi hupikwa kama mboga. Mmea huu pia hutumika kulainisha nyama, kutokana na kimeng'enya kilichomo kwenye utomvu wake mweupe, kinacholainisha nyama.
uses.dg: Matunda maivu nkuriwa dza garivyo. Matunda maitsi nkujitwa dza mboga. Mmea uhu piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda nyama ikale yuya, kpwa sababu ya kemikali (*enzyme*) iriyo kpwenye maziyage.

names.en: The plant is *mpapali* and the fruit *papali*. Digo growers distinguish varieties: *moyo wa simba*, with red flesh, and *moyo mwereru*. Swahili says *mpapai* for the plant and *papai* for the fruit. In English it is pawpaw or papaya.
names.sw: Mmea ni *mpapali* na tunda ni *papali*. Wakulima wa Kidigo hutofautisha aina zake: *moyo wa simba*, yenye nyama nyekundu, na *moyo mwereru*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mpapai* kwa mmea na *papai* kwa tunda. Kwa Kiingereza ni *pawpaw* au *papaya*.
names.dg: Mmea ni *mpapali* na tunda ni *papali*. Adigo anaophanda anatafwautisha aina: *moyo wa simba*, yenye nyama ya kundu, na *moyo mwereru*. Kpwa Chiswahili mmea ni *mpapai* na tunda ni *papai*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pawpaw* au *papaya*.

reason.en: Another homestead fruit eaten ripe or cooked green
reason.sw: Tunda lingine la nyumbani linaloliwa likiwa bivu au kupikwa likiwa bichi
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa mudzini, ambao matundage nkuriwa maivu au nkujitwa maitsi

reason.sw: Tunda lingine la kila siku la nyumbani
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa matunda ga chila siku wa mudzini

reason.en: Grown in the same home gardens
reason.sw: Hupandwa katika bustani hizo hizo za nyumbani
reason.dg: Unaphandwa kpwenye busitani zizo zizo za kaya

reason.en: Another tropical fruit introduced to the coast
reason.sw: Tunda lingine la kitropiki lililoletwa pwani
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina ra tsi za dzoho ririrorehwa pwani kula kure

definition.en: The papaya's male flower is still called ruwa (flower), although it bears no fruit, because it is colourful and looks like the female flower.
definition.sw: Ua dume la mpapai bado huitwa ruwa (ua), ingawa halizai tunda, kwa sababu lina rangi za kupendeza na linafanana na ua jike.
definition.dg: Ruwa ra chilume ra mpapali nkuihwa *ruwa* hata dza tarilavya tunda, kpwa sababu rina rangi nono na rinaoneka dza ruwa ra chichetu.

mgombato: mpapali (mi) pawpaw tree, papaya tree (Carica papaya); mpapai.
